title: Orttirma daraja: eng yaxshi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida qisqa va uzun sifatlardan to‘g‘ri orttirma daraja yasaysiz, in va of ni ajratasiz, ever bilan gap tuzasiz va shahringizning eng yaxshi hamda eng yomon tomonlari haqida gapirasiz.

scenes.title: Eng yaxshi, eng katta, eng qiziq
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ikki narsani solishtirdik: taller than, more expensive than. Bugun esa butun guruh ichidan eng birinchisini aytamiz: eng baland, eng arzon, eng yaxshi. Dars oxirida o‘z shahringizning eng yaxshi va eng yomon tomonlari haqida bemalol gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we compared two things. Today we say which one is the best of all.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! O‘tgan safar ikki narsani solishtirdik. Bugun hammasi ichida qaysi biri eng yaxshi ekanini aytamiz.

scenes.title: Orttirma daraja nima
board: Comparative: A is taller than B (ikkita)
Superlative: A is the tallest (uch va undan ko‘p)

examples.t: Anna is taller than Bob.
Anna is the tallest in the class.

scenes.say_native: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi. Orttirma daraja esa uchta yoki undan ko‘p narsadan birini ajratib ko‘rsatadi: eng baland, eng arzon. Ingliz tilida buning ikki yo‘li bor. Qisqa sifatlarga est qo‘shamiz, uzun sifatlar oldiga most qo‘yamiz. Ikkala holatda ham oldinda the bo‘lishi shart.
scenes.say: Anna is taller than Bob. But in the whole class, Anna is the tallest.
scenes.say_uz: Anna Bobdan balandroq. Lekin butun sinfda Anna eng baland.

scenes.title: Qisqa sifatlar: the + est
board: the tallest, the smallest, the oldest
the cheapest, the fastest, the longest

examples.t: Today is the coldest day of the year.
This is the cheapest shop in town.

scenes.say_native: Bir bo‘g‘inli qisqa sifatlarga est qo‘shamiz va oldiga the qo‘yamiz. Tall — the tallest, old — the oldest, cheap — the cheapest, fast — the fastest, long — the longest. Qiyosiy darajadagi er o‘rniga endi est keladi, than esa kerak emas. Chunki biz ikki narsani emas, butun guruhni nazarda tutamiz.
scenes.say: Tall, the tallest. Old, the oldest. Cheap, the cheapest. Fast, the fastest. Long, the longest.
scenes.say_uz: Baland, eng baland. Eski, eng eski. Arzon, eng arzon. Tez, eng tez. Uzun, eng uzun.

scenes.title: Qisqa sifatlar misollarda
board: It's the longest river in our region.
He's the fastest runner in the team.

examples.t: It is the oldest building in the city.
He is the fastest runner in the team.
That is the cheapest hotel here.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi eng arzon mehmonxona shu.

scenes.say_native: Mana bir nechta jumla. Shahardagi eng qadimiy bino, jamoadagi eng tez yuguruvchi, bu yerdagi eng arzon mehmonxona. Har birida the va est borligiga e’tibor bering. Mehmonxona gapida oldin that is, keyin the cheapest hotel here. Gap tuzilishi oddiy: to be, the, sifat est, ot.
scenes.say: It is the oldest building in the city. He is the fastest runner in the team. That is the cheapest hotel here.
scenes.say_uz: Bu shahardagi eng qadimiy bino. U jamoadagi eng tez yuguruvchi. Bu yerdagi eng arzon mehmonxona shu.

scenes.title: Imlo qoidalari

examples.t: It's the biggest park in Tashkent.
She's the happiest girl I know.
examples.uz: U men bilgan eng baxtli qiz.

scenes.say_native: Imloda uchta qoida bor, qiyosiy darajadagi bilan bir xil. Birinchisi: e bilan tugasa, faqat st qo‘shamiz, large — largest, nice — nicest. Ikkinchisi: bitta unli va bitta undoshdan iborat so‘zda undosh ikkilanadi, big — biggest, hot — hottest, thin — thinnest. Uchinchisi: undoshdan keyingi y harfi iest ga aylanadi, happy — happiest, easy — easiest, busy — busiest.
scenes.say: Large, the largest. Big, the biggest. Hot, the hottest. Happy, the happiest. Easy, the easiest.
scenes.say_uz: Katta, eng katta. Katta, eng katta. Issiq, eng issiq. Baxtli, eng baxtli. Oson, eng oson.

scenes.title: Imloni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq. To‘rtta sifatning orttirma darajasini ayting, the bilan birga. Nice, hot, busy va safe. Qaysi qoida mos kelishini o‘ylang: e bilan tugaydimi, undosh ikkilanadimi yoki y o‘zgaradimi.
scenes.say: Nice. Hot. Busy. Safe. Say the superlative of each one.
scenes.say_uz: Yoqimli. Issiq. Band. Xavfsiz. Har birining orttirma darajasini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: imlo
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Nice — the nicest, chunki e bilan tugaydi. Hot — the hottest, undosh ikkilanadi. Busy — the busiest, y harfi i ga aylanadi. Safe — the safest, yana e bilan tugaydi. Agar to‘rttasini ham to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, imlo qoidalarini yaxshi o‘zlashtirgansiz.
scenes.say: The nicest. The hottest. The busiest. The safest.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yoqimli. Eng issiq. Eng band. Eng xavfsiz.

scenes.title: Uzun sifatlar: the most
board: the most beautiful, the most expensive
the most interesting, the most dangerous

examples.t: This is the most expensive watch in the shop.
It was the most interesting lesson.

scenes.say_native: Uch va undan ko‘p bo‘g‘inli sifatlarga est qo‘shilmaydi. Ularning oldiga the most qo‘yamiz. Beautiful — the most beautiful, expensive — the most expensive, interesting — the most interesting, dangerous — the most dangerous. Sifat o‘zgarmaydi. Ikki bo‘g‘inli sifatlarning ko‘pchiligi ham shunday, masalan, careful va famous. Quiet va clever kabi ba’zilari esa ikkala usulni ham qabul qiladi.
scenes.say: The most beautiful. The most expensive. The most interesting. The most dangerous.
scenes.say_uz: Eng chiroyli. Eng qimmat. Eng qiziqarli. Eng xavfli.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtiring

examples.t: Samarkand is the most beautiful city for me.
examples.uz: Men uchun Samarqand eng chiroyli shahar.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bitta so‘z bor, eng. Eng katta, eng chiroyli, eng arzon. Ingliz tilida esa sifatning uzunligiga qarab ikki xil shakl tanlaysiz: est yoki the most. Yana bir farq: o‘zbekchada artikl yo‘q, inglizcha orttirma darajada esa the deyarli har doim kerak. Bu o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar tez-tez unutadigan joy, shuning uchun the ni odat qiling.
scenes.say: In Uzbek you say eng. In English you choose est or most, and you need the.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekchada eng deysiz. Inglizchada est yoki most tanlaysiz va the kerak bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Tipik xatolar: ikki marta va the yo‘q

examples.t: He is the tallest boy in the class.

scenes.say_native: Ikkita keng tarqalgan xato bor. Birinchisi: ikkala usulni aralashtirish, the most tallest. Faqat bittasini tanlang: tall bo‘lsa the tallest, expensive bo‘lsa the most expensive. Ikkinchisi: the ni tashlab ketish, most expensive hotel. Bu o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan xato. Yodda tuting: eng degan so‘z ingliz tilida har doim the bilan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Not the most tallest. Say the tallest. And do not forget the. The most expensive hotel.
scenes.say_uz: The most tallest emas. The tallest deng. Va the ni unutmang. The most expensive hotel.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta sifat uchun orttirma darajani ayting. Cold, interesting, cheap, dangerous. Qaysi biri est, qaysi biri the most bilan bo‘lishini tanlang. Oldidan the ni qo‘shishni unutmang.
scenes.say: Cold. Interesting. Cheap. Dangerous. What are the superlatives?
scenes.say_uz: Sovuq. Qiziqarli. Arzon. Xavfli. Orttirma darajalari qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: est yoki most
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Cold — the coldest. Interesting — the most interesting. Cheap — the cheapest. Dangerous — the most dangerous. Qisqa sifatlar est oladi, uzunlari the most bilan keladi. Bu qoidani yaxshi esda saqlang, chunki keyingi qismda qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydigan sifatlar bilan tanishamiz.
scenes.say: The coldest. The most interesting. The cheapest. The most dangerous.
scenes.say_uz: Eng sovuq. Eng qiziqarli. Eng arzon. Eng xavfli.

scenes.title: Qoidasiz sifatlar
board: little → the least; much, many → the most

examples.t: This is the best pizza in town.
That was the worst day of my life.
examples.uz: Bu hayotimdagi eng yomon kun edi.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi sifatlar qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydi, ularni yodlash kerak. Good — the best. Bad — the worst. Far — the farthest yoki the furthest, ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Little — the least, ya’ni eng kam. Much va many — the most, ya’ni eng ko‘p. Bu shakllar qiyosiy darajadagiga o‘xshash tarzda o‘zgarib ketadi, shuning uchun alohida o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Good, the best. Bad, the worst. Far, the furthest. Little, the least. Many, the most.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi, eng yaxshi. Yomon, eng yomon. Uzoq, eng uzoq. Oz, eng kam. Ko‘p, eng ko‘p.

scenes.title: Qoidasiz shakllar jumlada
board: He's the best player in our team.
She has the most books in the class.

examples.t: He is the best player in our team.
This is the worst coffee I know.
examples.uz: Bu men bilgan eng yomon qahva.

examples.t: She has the most books in the class.

scenes.say_native: Jumlalarni tinglang. U jamoadagi eng yaxshi o‘yinchi. Bu men bilgan eng yomon qahva. Sinfda eng ko‘p kitob unda. Oxirgi jumlada the most ot oldidan keldi, chunki many ning orttirma darajasi shu. Birinchi ikkitasida the best va the worst sifat vazifasida ot oldida turibdi.
scenes.say: He is the best player in our team. This is the worst coffee I know. She has the most books in the class.
scenes.say_uz: U jamoamizdagi eng yaxshi o‘yinchi. Bu men bilgan eng yomon qahva. Sinfda eng ko‘p kitob unda.

scenes.title: Goodest degan so‘z yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Eng yaxshi uchun the goodest yoki the most good demang. Ular xato. Faqat the best deyiladi. Xuddi shunday the baddest emas, the worst. Bu xato qiyosiy darajada ham bor edi: gooder emas, better. Qoidasiz sifatlarni bir marta aniq yodlab oling, keyin ular o‘z-o‘zidan chiqadi.
scenes.say: Not the goodest. The best. Not the baddest. The worst.
scenes.say_uz: The goodest emas. The best. The baddest emas. The worst.

scenes.title: Qoidasiz shakllarni to‘ldiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta jumla. Birinchisi: this is the, bo‘sh joy, film, good. Ikkinchisi: it was the, bo‘sh joy, test, bad. Uchinchisi: who has the, bo‘sh joy, money, much. Har bir bo‘sh joyga mos shaklni ayting.
scenes.say: This is the ... film, good. It was the ... test, bad. Who has the ... money, much?
scenes.say_uz: Bu ... film, yaxshi. Bu ... test edi, yomon. Kimda ... pul bor, ko‘p?

scenes.title: Javoblar: qoidasizlar

examples.t: This is the best film.
It was the worst test.
Who has the most money?

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: the best film. Ikkinchisi: the worst test. Uchinchisi: the most money. Much va many ning orttirma darajasi bitta, the most. Shuning uchun sanaladigan ot bilan ham, sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham the most ishlataveramiz.
scenes.say: The best film. The worst test. The most money.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yaxshi film. Eng yomon test. Eng ko‘p pul.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: est va the

examples.t: the biggest
the easiest

scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda ikki narsaga e’tibor bering. Birinchisi: est qismi kuchsiz, taxminan ist deb o‘qiladi. Tallest so‘zida urg‘u tall da, est esa tez va yengil. Ikkinchisi: the unli tovushdan oldin di deb o‘qiladi, the oldest, the easiest. Undoshdan oldin esa odatdagidek də, the tallest, the biggest.
scenes.say: The tallest. The biggest. The oldest. The easiest. The best. The worst.
scenes.say_uz: Eng baland. Eng katta. Eng qadimiy. Eng oson. Eng yaxshi. Eng yomon.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang va talaffuzga e’tibor bering. Est ni bo‘rttirmang, yengil ayting. The oldest va the easiest da the oldin di bo‘ladi. Worst so‘zida oxirida st undoshlari birga keladi, ularni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: The tallest. The biggest. The oldest. The easiest. The best. The worst.
scenes.say_uz: Eng baland. Eng katta. Eng qadimiy. Eng oson. Eng yaxshi. Eng yomon.

scenes.title: Talaffuz bo‘yicha izoh
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi chiqdi. Eslab qoling: tallest so‘zida kuchli bo‘g‘in birinchisi, ikkinchi bo‘g‘in ist kabi qisqa. Worst so‘zida ur harfi uzun tovush beradi, oxirida s va t aniq eshitilishi kerak. Bu so‘zni ko‘pchilik w o‘rniga v deb o‘qiydi, siz esa lablarni yumaloqlab w deb ayting.
scenes.say: Tallest, oldest, worst. Say the end of each word clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Eng baland, eng qadimiy, eng yomon. Har bir so‘zning oxirini aniq ayting.

scenes.title: In bilan: joy va guruh
board: the tallest student in the class
the best player in the team

examples.t: Tashkent is the biggest city in Uzbekistan.
She is the youngest in my family.

scenes.say_native: Orttirma darajadan keyin guruhni ko‘rsatish kerak bo‘lsa, ikki so‘z ishlatiladi: in va of. Joy yoki bitta guruh nomi kelsa, in ishlatamiz. In the world, in Uzbekistan, in the city, in my family, in the class, in the team. Ya’ni guruhni bir butun joy yoki jamoa sifatida ko‘ramiz. O‘zbekchada bu ko‘pincha dagi qo‘shimchasi: sinfdagi, dunyodagi.
scenes.say: Tashkent is the biggest city in Uzbekistan. She is the youngest in my family.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent O‘zbekistondagi eng katta shahar. U oilamizdagi eng kichigi.

scenes.title: Of bilan: ro‘yxat va vaqt
board: the best of all, the best of the three
the hottest day of the year

examples.t: She is the best of my friends.
July is the hottest month of the year.

scenes.say_native: Of ni esa alohida elementlar ro‘yxati yoki ko‘plik bilan ishlatamiz. The best of all, the best of the three, the best of my friends. Shuningdek vaqt bilan: the hottest day of the year, the best week of my life. Mana qoida: bir butun joy yoki guruh bo‘lsa in, aniq ko‘plik yoki vaqt bo‘lsa of. Ikkalasi o‘zbekchada ichida yoki dagi deb tarjima qilinadi.
scenes.say: She is the best of my friends. July is the hottest month of the year.
scenes.say_uz: U do‘stlarim ichida eng yaxshisi. Iyul yilning eng issiq oyi.

scenes.title: In va of aralashdi
board: ✗ the best student of the class
✓ the best student in the class
scenes.say_native: Xatolarni ko‘rib chiqamiz. The best student of the class xato, to‘g‘risi in the class, chunki sinf bitta guruh. The best in my friends ham xato, to‘g‘risi of my friends, chunki friends ko‘plik ro‘yxati. Oddiy yo‘l: oldin ko‘plik yoki vaqt turibdimi, deb qarang. Bo‘lsa of, bo‘lmasa in.
scenes.say: The best student in the class. The best of my friends.
scenes.say_uz: Sinfdagi eng yaxshi o‘quvchi. Do‘stlarim ichida eng yaxshisi.

scenes.title: In yoki of?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta jumla, har biriga in yoki of tanlang. Birinchisi: the tallest building, bo‘sh joy, the world. Ikkinchisi: the happiest day, bo‘sh joy, my life. Uchinchisi: the oldest, bo‘sh joy, the three. To‘rtinchisi: the best team, bo‘sh joy, the league.
scenes.say: The tallest building in or of the world? The happiest day in or of my life?
scenes.say_uz: Dunyodagi eng baland bino? Hayotimdagi eng baxtli kun?

scenes.title: Javoblar: in yoki of

examples.t: The happiest day of my life.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: in the world, chunki dunyo bitta joy. Ikkinchisi: of my life, vaqt va hayot bilan of. Uchinchisi: of the three, ro‘yxat bilan of. To‘rtinchisi: in the league, chunki liga bitta guruh. Hammasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, bu qoidani o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: In the world. Of my life. Of the three. In the league.
scenes.say_uz: Dunyoda. Hayotimda. Uchtasidan. Ligada.

scenes.title: Ever bilan orttirma daraja
board: the + superlative + (noun) + I've ever + past participle
It's the best film I've ever seen.
the most delicious meal I've ever had

examples.t: It is the best film I have ever seen.
examples.uz: Bu men hozirgacha ko‘rgan eng yaxshi film.

examples.t: This is the most delicious meal I have ever had.
examples.uz: Bu men hozirgacha yegan eng mazali taom.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida eng yaxshi narsani tajribangiz asosida aytganda ever so‘zi qo‘shiladi. Tuzilishi: orttirma daraja, ot, I have ever, fe’lning uchinchi shakli. Ever shu yerda hozirgacha, umr bo‘yi degan ma’noni bildiradi. Bu o‘zbekchada hozirgacha ko‘rgan eng yaxshi film degan gapga to‘g‘ri keladi. Present perfect haqida kelgusi darslarda ko‘proq gaplashamiz, hozir faqat shu qolipni oling.
scenes.say: It is the best film I have ever seen. This is the most delicious meal I have ever had.
scenes.say_uz: Bu men ko‘rgan eng yaxshi film. Bu men yegan eng mazali taom.

scenes.title: Ever bilan ko‘proq misollar
board: the funniest person I've ever met
the most beautiful place I've ever visited

examples.t: He is the funniest person I have ever met.
examples.uz: U men uchragan eng kulgili odam.

examples.t: It is the most beautiful place I have ever visited.
examples.uz: Bu men borgan eng go‘zal joy.

examples.t: This is the longest book I have ever read.
examples.uz: Bu men o‘qigan eng uzun kitob.

scenes.say_native: Yana misollar. U men uchratgan eng kulgili odam. Bu men borgan eng go‘zal joy. Bu men o‘qigan eng uzun kitob. Qolip bir xil: the, orttirma daraja, ot, I have ever, keyin met, visited yoki read kabi fe’l shakli. Ba’zan I have o‘rniga qisqa I’ve ham aytiladi.
scenes.say: He is the funniest person I have ever met. It is the most beautiful place I have ever visited. This is the longest book I have ever read.
scenes.say_uz: U men uchratgan eng kulgili odam. Bu men borgan eng go‘zal joy. Bu men o‘qigan eng uzun kitob.

scenes.title: Kerakli fe’l shakllari
scenes.say_native: Ever bilan fe’lning uchinchi shaklini ishlatamiz. Ba’zilari muntazam, ed bilan tugaydi: visited, watched. Ko‘pchiligi esa noto‘g‘ri. See — seen, eat — eaten, have — had, meet — met, be — been, hear — heard. Read yozilishi o‘zgarmaydi, lekin o‘qilishi red bo‘ladi. Bularni ro‘yxat sifatida yodlab oling, chunki ever gaplarida ular tez-tez kerak.
scenes.say: See, seen. Eat, eaten. Have, had. Meet, met. Be, been. Hear, heard.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rmoq. Yemoq. Ega bo‘lmoq. Uchratmoq. Bo‘lmoq. Eshitmoq.

scenes.title: Ever gapda adashish
board: ✗ the best film I saw ever
✗ the best film I have ever saw
✓ the best film I have ever seen
✗ the best film ever I have seen
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato bor. Birinchisi: ever ni oxiriga qo‘yish, saw ever. Ever have bilan fe’l orasida turadi. Ikkinchisi: have ever dan keyin o‘tgan zamon saw ishlatish. Bu yerda faqat uchinchi shakl, seen kerak. Uchinchisi: ever ni have dan oldin qo‘yish, ever I have seen. Tartib doim shunday: orttirma daraja, ot, I have ever seen.
scenes.say: The best film I have ever seen. Not saw. Not I saw ever.
scenes.say_uz: Men ko‘rgan eng yaxshi film. Saw emas. I saw ever emas.

scenes.title: Ever gapini tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni tuzing, hammasi the bilan boshlanadi. Birinchisi: good meal, I have, eat. Ikkinchisi: funny film, I, see. Uchinchisi: long trip, I have. Orttirma darajani ishlatib, ever bilan to‘liq gap ayting.
scenes.say: Make three sentences with ever. Good meal, eat. Funny film, see. Long trip, have.
scenes.say_uz: Ever bilan uchta gap tuzing. Yaxshi taom, yemoq. Kulgili film, ko‘rmoq. Uzoq safar, qilmoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ever gaplari
board: The best meal I have ever eaten.
The funniest film I have ever seen.
The longest trip I have ever had.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: the best meal I have ever eaten. Ikkinchisi: the funniest film I have ever seen. Uchinchisi: the longest trip I have ever had. Eslatib o‘tamiz, funny sifati y bilan tugagani uchun funniest bo‘ladi. Boshqa to‘g‘ri variantlar ham mumkin, masalan the best meal I have ever had.
scenes.say: The best meal I have ever eaten. The funniest film I have ever seen. The longest trip I have ever had.
scenes.say_uz: Men yegan eng yaxshi taom. Men ko‘rgan eng kulgili film. Men qilgan eng uzoq safar.

scenes.title: One of the ...
board: one of the + superlative + plural noun

examples.t: Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia.
examples.uz: Samarqand Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri.

examples.t: She is one of the best teachers in school.
examples.uz: U maktabdagi eng yaxshi o‘qituvchilardan biri.

scenes.say_native: Juda foydali qolip: one of the. Agar bitta eng birinchi emas, balki eng yaxshilardan biri bo‘lsa, shuni ishlatamiz. One of the biggest cities, one of the best players. Muhim: of the dan keyin ot ko‘plikda bo‘ladi, cities, players, ya’ni bir nechtasidan biri. Fe’l esa birlikda qoladi, chunki gap one haqida.
scenes.say: Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia. She is one of the best teachers in school.
scenes.say_uz: Samarqand Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri. U maktabdagi eng yaxshi o‘qituvchilardan biri.

scenes.title: One of the dan keyin birlik
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda o‘zbek tilidan kelgan xato ko‘p uchraydi. O‘zbekchada eng katta shaharlardan biri deymiz va ko‘plik belgisi ot oxirida bo‘ladi. Ingliz tilida ham ko‘plik shart: one of the biggest cities. One of the biggest city deb aytmang. Bu qolipda har doim ko‘plik ot keladi.
scenes.say: One of the biggest cities. One of the best players. Always plural.
scenes.say_uz: Eng katta shaharlardan biri. Eng yaxshi o‘yinchilardan biri. Doim ko‘plikda.

scenes.title: One of the bilan gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta qisqa maslahatdan one of the bilan gap tuzing. Birinchisi: big city, world. Ikkinchisi: good restaurant, town. Uchinchisi: old building, my city. Ot ko‘plikda bo‘lishini va in ishlatilishini unutmang.
scenes.say: Make sentences with one of the. Big city, world. Good restaurant, town. Old building, my city.
scenes.say_uz: One of the bilan gaplar tuzing. Katta shahar, dunyo. Yaxshi restoran, shahar. Eski bino, mening shahrim.

scenes.title: Javoblar: one of the
board: Tokyo is one of the biggest cities in the world.
It's one of the best restaurants in town.
It's one of the oldest buildings in my city.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: Tokyo is one of the biggest cities in the world. Ikkinchisi: it is one of the best restaurants in town. Uchinchisi: it is one of the oldest buildings in my city. Har birida ko‘plik ot va in bilan joy bor. Sizning versiyangiz boshqa so‘zlar bilan bo‘lsa ham, qolip bir xil bo‘lsa, bu to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Tokyo is one of the biggest cities in the world. It is one of the best restaurants in town.
scenes.say_uz: Tokio dunyodagi eng katta shaharlardan biri. Bu shahardagi eng yaxshi restoranlardan biri.

scenes.title: Favourite va best

examples.t: My favourite food is plov.
What is your favourite film?

scenes.say_native: Endi sevimlilar haqida. Favourite so‘zi orttirma daraja emas, ot oldidan keladigan sifat, va the bilan emas, my yoki your bilan ishlatiladi. My favourite food, your favourite film. Favourite sizga yoqqan narsa, shaxsiy tanlov. The best esa baholash, yaxshiroq bilan solishtirish. Sevimli taom eng yaxshi bo‘lmasligi mumkin. Amerikacha yozilishi favorite.
scenes.say: My favourite food is plov. What is your favourite film?
scenes.say_uz: Mening sevimli taomim palov. Sevimli filmingiz qaysi?

scenes.title: Dialog: sevimlilar
board: A: What's your favourite city? B: Samarkand.
A: Why? B: It's the most beautiful place I've ever visited.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Anna va Ali sevimli shahar haqida gaplashadi. Ali Samarqandni tanlaydi va sababini ever bilan aytadi. Tinglab, ikki savolga javob toping: Alining sevimli shahri qaysi, va u nima uchun uni yaxshi ko‘radi.
scenes.say: Anna: What's your favourite city, Ali? Ali: Samarkand. Anna: Why? Ali: It's the most beautiful place I have ever visited. And the food is the best in the country. Anna: I want to go there!
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Sevimli shahring qaysi, Ali? Ali: Samarqand. Anna: Nega? Ali: Bu men borgan eng go‘zal joy. Taomlar ham mamlakatdagi eng yaxshisi. Anna: Men ham borgim keladi!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchisi: Alining sevimli shahri qaysi? Ikkinchisi: nima uchun u shaharni yaxshi ko‘radi? Uchinchisi: Anna nima istaydi? Javoblarni to‘liq jumla bilan ayting.
scenes.say: What is Ali's favourite city? Why does he like it? What does Anna want?
scenes.say_uz: Alining sevimli shahri qaysi? U nega uni yaxshi ko‘radi? Anna nimani xohlaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Alining sevimli shahri Samarqand. U buni yaxshi ko‘radi, chunki bu u borgan eng go‘zal joy va u yerdagi taomlar mamlakatdagi eng yaxshisi. Anna esa u yerga borishni xohlaydi. Ko‘rdingizmi, dialogda ikkita orttirma daraja bor edi: the most beautiful va the best.
scenes.say: Ali's favourite city is Samarkand. It is the most beautiful place he has ever visited.
scenes.say_uz: Alining sevimli shahri Samarqand. Bu u borgan eng go‘zal joy.

scenes.title: Rekordlar va faktlar
board: the highest, the longest, the fastest, the largest
Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
The cheetah is the fastest land animal.

examples.t: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world.
examples.uz: Ko‘k kit dunyodagi eng katta hayvon.

scenes.say_native: Orttirma daraja rekordlar va faktlar uchun ham kerak. Everest dunyodagi eng baland tog‘. Ko‘k kit dunyodagi eng katta hayvon. Gepard quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon. Bunday gaplarda ko‘pincha in the world qo‘shiladi. Faktlarda ever kerak emas, chunki biz shaxsiy tajribani emas, umumiy haqiqatni aytyapmiz.
scenes.say: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. The blue whale is the biggest animal. The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
scenes.say_uz: Everest dunyodagi eng baland tog‘. Ko‘k kit eng katta hayvon. Gepard quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon.

scenes.title: Dialog: viktorina
board: A: What is the largest country in the world?
B: Russia. A: And the smallest? B: Vatican City.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: ikki do‘st viktorina o‘ynayapti. Tinglang, savollar nima haqida ekanini va javoblarini toping. Bu yerda ever yo‘q, chunki bular umumiy faktlar. Oxirida kim to‘g‘ri javob berdi, buni ham eshiting.
scenes.say: Tom: What is the largest country in the world? Mia: Russia. Tom: Correct! And what is the smallest country? Mia: Vatican City. Tom: Right again! What is the fastest land animal? Mia: The cheetah!
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Dunyodagi eng katta mamlakat qaysi? Mia: Rossiya. Tom: To‘g‘ri! Eng kichik mamlakat-chi? Mia: Vatikan. Tom: Yana to‘g‘ri! Quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon-chi? Mia: Gepard!

scenes.title: Viktorina javoblari
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchisi: dunyodagi eng katta mamlakat qaysi? Ikkinchisi: eng kichik mamlakat? Uchinchisi: quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon? Iloji bo‘lsa to‘liq jumla bilan ayting: Russia is the largest country in the world.
scenes.say: What is the largest country? The smallest country? The fastest land animal?
scenes.say_uz: Eng katta mamlakat qaysi? Eng kichigi? Quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon?

scenes.title: Javoblar: viktorina
board: Vatican City is the smallest country.
The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Eng katta mamlakat Rossiya. Eng kichigi Vatikan. Quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon gepard. Siz bu savollarga to‘liq jumla bilan javob bergan bo‘lsangiz, ayniqsa yaxshi. Chunki aynan shunday gaplarni uy vazifasida ham ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: Russia is the largest country. Vatican City is the smallest. The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
scenes.say_uz: Rossiya eng katta mamlakat. Vatikan eng kichigi. Gepard quruqlikdagi eng tez hayvon.

scenes.title: Fikringizni bildirish
board: In my opinion, ... is the most ...

examples.t: I think this is the best café in town.
examples.uz: Menimcha, bu shahardagi eng yaxshi kafe.

examples.t: In my opinion, winter is the worst season.
examples.uz: Mening fikrimcha, qish eng yomon fasl.

scenes.say_native: Orttirma darajadagi gaplar ko‘pincha fikr bo‘ladi, fakt emas. Shuning uchun I think, in my opinion, for me kabi iboralar bilan boshlash tabiiy. Menimcha, bu shahardagi eng yaxshi kafe. Fikrimcha, qish eng yomon fasl. Bunday iboralar gapingizni muloyim qiladi va suhbatdoshingizga o‘z fikrini aytishga imkon beradi.
scenes.say: I think this is the best café in town. In my opinion, winter is the worst season.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, bu shahardagi eng yaxshi kafe. Fikrimcha, qish eng yomon fasl.

scenes.title: O‘z shahringiz haqida gapiring
board: the biggest ... the best ... the worst ... one of the ...
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy vazifa. O‘z shahringiz yoki qishlog‘ingiz haqida to‘rtta gap ayting. Birinchisi: eng katta yoki eng chiroyli joy. Ikkinchisi: eng yaxshi narsa. Uchinchisi: eng yomon narsa, masalan, eng gavjum yo‘l. To‘rtinchisi: one of the bilan. Misol sifatida mening gapim: it is the biggest park in town.
scenes.say: Now you speak. Tell me four sentences about your city. Use the biggest, the best, the worst and one of the.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz gapirasiz. Shahringiz haqida to‘rtta gap ayting. The biggest, the best, the worst va one of the dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: The biggest street is very busy.
It is one of the biggest cities in Central Asia.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna javob. My city is Tashkent. The worst thing is the traffic. The best thing is the food. It is one of the biggest cities in Central Asia. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘ladi, bu yaxshi. Asosiysi, har bir gapda the va orttirma daraja bor edi, one of the dan keyin esa ko‘plik ot ishlatildi. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, qaytadan ayting.
scenes.say: The worst thing is the traffic. The best thing is the food. Tashkent is one of the biggest cities in Central Asia.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yomon narsa tirbandlik. Eng yaxshi narsa taomlar. Toshkent Markaziy Osiyodagi eng katta shaharlardan biri.

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlash
board: short: the tallest | long: the most beautiful
in the world / of my friends
scenes.say_native: Darsni yakunlaymiz. Qisqa sifatlar the est oladi, uzun sifatlar the most bilan keladi. Good — best, bad — worst. Guruh uchun in the world, ro‘yxat uchun of my friends. Tajriba haqida the best film I have ever seen. Va one of the dan keyin ko‘plik ot. Shu besh qoida bilan istalgan narsaning eng yaxshisini ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Short adjectives take est, long ones take most. Good is best, bad is worst. And always use the.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa sifatlar est, uzunlari most oladi. Good best, bad worst bo‘ladi. Va doim the ishlating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: best and worst things about your city
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: shahringizning eng yaxshi va eng yomon tomonlari haqida kamida oltita gap yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting. Hech bo‘lmaganda ikkita the best, ikkita the worst va bitta one of the ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir orttirma darajada the bor va the most yoki est to‘g‘ri tanlangan. Keyingi darsda sog‘liq mavzusini, ya’ni shifokorda va dorixonada gaplashishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: write six sentences about the best and worst things in your city. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: shahringizning eng yaxshi va eng yomon tomonlari haqida oltita gap yozing. Yana ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Shahringizning eng yaxshi va eng yomon tomonlari haqida kamida oltita gap yozing yoki ayting. Kamida ikkita the best, ikkita the worst va bitta one of the ishlating. Mezon: har bir orttirma darajada the bor va est yoki the most to‘g‘ri tanlangan.

quiz.why_uz: Katta — big, qisqa sifat: the biggest. The siz bo‘lmaydi.
Good ning orttirma darajasi qoidasiz: the best.

quiz.q: She is the happiest girl ___ the class.
quiz.why_uz: Sinf bitta guruh, shuning uchun in the class.

quiz.q: It was the hottest day ___ the year.
quiz.why_uz: Vaqt bilan of ishlatiladi: of the year.

quiz.q: It is the best film I have ever ___.
quiz.why_uz: Have ever dan keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli: seen.

quiz.q: Samarkand is one of the oldest ___ in Central Asia.
quiz.why_uz: One of the dan keyin ko‘plik ot: cities.

options: He is the most tallest boy.
He is the more tall boy.
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa sifat: the tallest. Ikki usulni aralashtirmang.

quiz.q: This is ___ expensive hotel I know.
quiz.why_uz: Uzun sifat oldidan the most keladi.

quiz.q: What is the superlative of busy?
quiz.why_uz: y harfi undoshdan keyin iest ga aylanadi: the busiest.
Sevimli rang: favourite colour, the siz, your bilan.
